01 / Research instrument

Three questions.
One research program.

Use the instrument to inspect the same intelligence problem at three scales: computation inside the model, cognition between agents, and consequences across time.

Confident Decoding

The final layer is not always the most truthful layer.

Aligned models repeatedly move through Guess → Refine → Perturb. Scrub the model depth to see where reasoning peaks before the final-layer alignment tax.

MarioLM

Turn evaluation into an experiential world.

MarioLM unifies trajectory-level evaluation and optimization through causally grounded scenes, latent user states, event chains, and temporally persistent consequences.
